title: Table 4. Document revision history
text_helper: Table 4. Document revision history — section 4 Bootloader protocol version evolution. Date, Revision, Changes.

rows: Table 2: USART bootloader commands: added Extended Erase command; removed footnote 2 concerning read protection from the Readout Protect command. Communication safety: amended Note 1. Section 3.1: Get command: updated byte 10. Updated Figure 10: Go command: host side for missing ACK state. Section 3.7: Write Memory command: added Note 1 and Note 2. Figure 12, and Figure 13: added notes regarding N+1. Added Section 3.8: Extended Erase Memory command. Table 3: Bootloader protocol versions: added v3.0.

Added Note:, Note and Note:. Changed all occurrences of "ROP" by "RDP" including in figures: Figure 9., Figure 11., Figure 13., Figure 15., Figure 17., Figure 19., Figure 21., Figure 23., Figure 25.. Added Table 1: Applicable products.

Added Version 3.1 in Table 3: Bootloader protocol versions. Updated "byte 4" value in Section 3.3: Get ID command. Replaced "address" by "ID" in this Note 1. Replaced "End of EER" by "End of Go" in Figure 10: Go command: host side. Updated first sentence in Section 3.7: Write Memory command. Removed "& address=0x1FFF F800" and replaced the two tests "Flash memory address?" and "RAM address?" by a single test in Figure 13: Write Memory command: device side. Precised missing "Y" values in the third test of Figure 17: Extended Erase Memory command: device side. Added Note: above Figure 24: Readout Unprotect command: host side.
Replaced "STM32L151xx, STM32L152xx and STM32L162xx" by "STM32L1 series" in Table 1: Applicable products.

Updated Table 1: Applicable products. Removed footnote 4 and added footnote 3.in Table 2: USART bootloader commands. Removed section 3.1 Device-dependent bootloader parameters. Updated Figure 10: Go command: host side and Figure 11: Go command: device side. Updated Section 3.6: Write Memory command.
Introduced STM32L4 and STM32F7 series, hence updated Introduction and Table 1: Applicable products.
